purpose: Consolidated scientific synthesis of audited Phase A, Phase B, and Phase C-1 findings

phase_a_summary.established_m1_finding: M1 (information absent) is inconsistent with the tested aggregate targets. The frozen Stage8.1 causal state contains nonlinear predictive information about the tested future H7-H12 transmission statistics beyond P0.

b2_pinball_loss.dependence_caveat: The reported p < 0.0001 treats all 604 hourly observations as independent, without accounting for origin-level clustering.

phase_b_summary.b3_procedural_limitation: B3 combined threshold was NOT demonstrably frozen before computation. B3 is procedurally compromised and remains exploratory only.

phase_c1_summary.initial_execution: INVALID_HISTORICAL_ONLY (canonical fold indexing loop mismatch range(5) vs 1..5)
phase_c1_summary.controlled_finding: Across all six H7-H12 horizons, the specified GBDT probe extracted positive incremental out-of-fold predictive information from P1 relative to P0.

A_demonstrated: P1 contains substantial nonlinear predictive information about aggregate targets T1-T3 (Phase A).
M1 (information absent) is inconsistent with tested aggregate targets (Phase A) and individual hourly transmission targets k(t+h) (Phase C-1).
The champion point forecasts have a mean normalized rank of 0.4459 within tested five-neighbour ensembles (Phase B).
Champion q=.5 pinball loss (0.1058) is lower than crude 5-neighbour empirical median loss (0.1267) (Phase B).
GBDT probes achieve positive out-of-fold incremental predictive power (ΔR² from +0.3037 to +0.7013) for individual hourly targets k(t+7) to k(t+12) relative to P0 (Phase C-1).
B_supported_consistent_with: Phase B diagnostics are consistent with conditional-median/hedging behavior.
The Ridge vs GBDT contrast is consistent with nonlinear information structure, but does not establish inherent physical nonlinearity.
C_not_established: Stage8.1 representation limitation (M2 is not established by C-1 due to model-class, loss, and capacity confounders).
M3 point-loss / uncertainty limitation (not established by C-1).
Event-timing uncertainty as a sole mechanism (not established by C-1).
Any unique mechanism explaining Stage8.1 hourly point forecast error.
